title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: This is our classroom. It's big and bright.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的教室，又大又明亮。

sentences.en: There is a library on the first floor.
How many students are there in your class?
There are forty students in my class.
Our playground is behind the building.
sentences.zh: 我们的操场在教学楼后面。

sentences.en: Come in and have a look!

plan.title: 跟读第 7–9 句

plan.title: 不看书，说给家长听
